import Mathlib
namespace TrialArithmetic
def Statement : Prop := forall n : Nat, (n + 1)^2 = n^2 + 2*n + 1
end TrialArithmetic

import Mathlib
namespace TrialDivisibility
def Statement : Prop := forall n : Nat, Dvd.dvd (2 : Nat) (n * (n + 1))
end TrialDivisibility

import Mathlib
namespace TrialSets
def Statement : Prop := forall s t : Finset Nat, (s ∪ t).card + (s ∩ t).card = s.card + t.card
end TrialSets

import Mathlib
namespace TrialLogic
def Statement : Prop := forall P Q R : Prop, (P -> Q) -> (Q -> R) -> P -> R
end TrialLogic

import Mathlib
namespace TrialFunctions
def Statement : Prop := forall f g : Nat -> Nat, Function.Injective f -> Function.Injective g -> Function.Injective (fun x => g (f x))
end TrialFunctions

import Mathlib
namespace TrialFalse
def Statement : Prop := forall n : Nat, n + 1 <= n
end TrialFalse
